meta.title: Miel, coffee & brunch
meta.description: Specialty coffee and homemade brunch in the heart of Mons. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 8am to 5pm.

home.bandText: No booking needed: sit down for brunch, or grab your coffee on the way. Made to order, served with a smile.

info.heroTitle: Specialty coffee, homemade brunch and one long table where nobody watches the clock.
info.addressText: At the end of Rue de la Clef, five minutes from the Grand-Place. Come in, sit wherever you like, we'll take care of the rest.
info.noBooking: No booking needed, just come as you are.
info.storyText: A coffee and brunch house in the heart of Mons. Big windows, one long table and pancakes until close.
info.storyBy: Léa grew up among her grandfather's beehives in Hainaut. By age 8, she was putting honey in everything, even soup. At 25, she left her desk job to train as a barista, and in 2024 she opened Miel in the heart of Mons. Or so the regulars say.
info.storyBy2: Since then, she has sourced her honey from a local beekeeper and baked the menu's pastries every morning. Her rule: one long table, good coffee, and nobody watching the clock.
